files.file: Main page component: Portfolio attribution analysis with portfolio/period selectors, positioning data fetch, and tab navigation
Barrel export: exports Attribution component and all types
Type definitions: AssetClass, Instrument, InstrumentAnalytics, PortfolioHolding, Portfolio, DurationByAssetClass, DurationByBucket, PortfolioSummary, PositioningData
ETF categorization: Maps tickers to asset classes and segments (Fixed Income, Equity, Cash, Hedge); includes helper functions and segment ordering
Visual comparison of actual style positioning vs benchmark with diverging bar charts and attribution table
Asset allocation attribution table showing style weight, policy weight, tilt, allocation effect, fund selection, and total attribution
Interactive holdings table with sorting, filtering by asset class, and CSV export capability
Attribution tab wrapper: renders StylePolicyComparison with portfolio and period selectors
Selection tab: Attribution analysis with QTD/YTD/1Y/SI periods showing fund selection and style allocation effects (large file, 84.7KB)
Holdings tab: Treemap visualization and heatmap table of portfolio holdings with performance coloring (26.8KB, uses useEffect)
Allocation heatmap panel: Shows attribution breakdown by asset class and segment using color-coded heatmap
Portfolio radial charts panel: Visual representation of portfolio composition using radial/circular charts
Attribution data builder: Constructs hierarchical attribution structure from holdings and returns data (Asset Class > Segment > ETF)

page_structure.component: Main page component with portfolio selector (UST, ST, INT, LTC, LTA), period selector (QTD, YTD, 1Y, SI), and two main sections: StylePolicyComparison (header) and SelectionTab (body)
page_structure.section: Displays style vs benchmark positioning with diverging bar charts per asset class (Fixed Income, Equity) and detailed attribution table
Attribution analysis showing fund selection and style allocation effects with QTD/YTD/1Y/SI period support (large component with extensive logic)
Treemap visualization of portfolio holdings (size = weight, color = performance) with supporting heatmap table
page_structure.panel: Heatmap visualization of attribution breakdown by asset class and segment (collapsed/expandable tree structure)
Radial/circular chart visualization of portfolio composition by asset class

Get benchmark returns from benchmark mapping - currently hardcoded null

data_flow.flow: 1. Attribution.tsx fetches getPositioningData() via useQuery (positioning-data key) 2. data_as_of registered with useYangDataAsOf('positioning', dataAsOf) 3. Portfolio and period state passed to StylePolicyComparison and SelectionTab

1. Fetches getAllocationSummary() via useQuery (allocation-summary key) 2. Registers data_as_of with useYangDataAsOf('allocation_summary', ...) 3. Renders diverging bars per asset class and AssetAllocationSummary child component

1. Fetches getAllocationSummary() and getHoldingsAttribution() via parallel useQuery calls 2. Merges data: allocation weights from first, equity/fixed income breakdowns from second 3. Renders attribution table with color-coded cells

1. Multiple useEffect hooks fetch: getPositioningData(), getETFPeriodReturns(), getHoldingsAttribution(), getAUMSummary() 2. buildAttributionData() structures holdings into Asset Class > Segment > ETF hierarchy 3. Renders treemap and table with period-specific attribution metrics
1. useEffect hooks fetch: getPositioningData(), getHoldingsAttribution(), getAUMSummary() 2. Treemap sized by weight, colored by return 3. Heatmap table shows performance across periods

dependencies.dependency: Portal proxy endpoints (in @/api/portal-proxy): getPositioningData, getAllocationSummary, getHoldingsAttribution, getETFPeriodReturns, getAUMSummary
useYangDataAsOf from @/hooks/useDataSource - central data timestamp registry
useQuery from @tanstack/react-query - data caching with 5min staleTime and 30min gcTime
buildAttributionData - constructs hierarchical attribution structure from holdings + returns
ETF_CATEGORIZATION from constants/etf-categories - maps 30+ tickers to categories and segments

Passes portfolio, period, and change handlers. SelectionTab is main body section.
